winks.rationale: The surname 'Frost' is itself the name of a small Texas town (also Frost, MN).
'Brazil' is the exact name of a real city in Indiana, ignoring the country.
'China' is the exact name of real US towns (China, TX and China, ME).
The word 'Pope' is the exact name of US counties (Pope County, AR/IL/MN).
'Window Rock' is the exact name of a real town in Arizona (Navajo Nation capital).
Spanish 'llanos' literally means 'the plains', and The Plains is a real US village in Virginia.
The word 'Lime' is itself a US place name (Lime, OR) embedded in 'Lime City'.
The surname 'Davis' is the exact name of Davis, California (and Davis County).
The surname 'Smith' is the exact name of many US counties (Smith County, TX/KS/MS/TN).
